# Hoffmeyer Plumbing & Heating

> Hoffmeyer Plumbing & Heating Limited is a plumbing, heating, cooling, and gas contractor at 55 Kingston St in Goderich, Ontario, serving Goderich and Huron County across residential and commercial plumbing, drain and sewer work, furnaces, boilers, air conditioning, hydronic and radiant heating, water heaters, fireplaces, and natural gas and propane since 1958. A three-generation, family-run business, it is now part of the Jayden's Mechanical family.

- Also known as: Hoffmeyer Plumbing & Heating, Hoffmeyer Plumbing, Hoffmeyer Plumbing & Heating Limited, Hoffmeyer Goderich
- Founded: May 2, 1958, Goderich, Ontario, Canada (as Near & Hoffmeyer; three generations: Jack Hoffmeyer, Doug Hoffmeyer, Chris Hoffmeyer)
- Parent: Jayden's Mechanical (https://jaydensmechanical.com) - Goderich branch since 2023
- Phone: (519) 237-4328 (office, answered 24/7)
- Email: info@jaydensmechanical.com
- Address: 55 Kingston St, Goderich, ON N7A 3K3
- Hours: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm, Sat 8am-12pm; 24-hour emergency service
